wholePhysicalScope: Mapped tower and market hall with open central courtyard, the exact public-domain Qualla original, city height and lean, and original source terrain.
lodDetails: Four levels retain three tower stages, the clock faces, battlements and open court. Near levels add tracery, finials, and chapel and market hall window details.
limitations: The model covers the 2005 belfry and market hall exterior around the courtyard. The 83 m height, one-meter southeast lean and mapped outlines set the principal controls.
Stage heights, the courtyard galleries, rear fenestration, roof details and Gothic ornament are estimated or simplified.
